name: com.llmvisibilitytracker/ai-brand-visibility-geo-citation-mcp
title: LLMVisibilityTracker — AI Search & GEO Brand Citation MCP
description: Track brand citations, rankings, and share-of-voice across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini.

tools.name: check_llm_brand_prompt
tools.description: Execute a real-time buying-intent prompt on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, or Gemini and inspect whether a target brand is mentioned, its 1-based recommendation rank, sentiment, visibility score (0–100), excerpt, and cited URLs. Cost: 50 Credits ($0.005, 24h cached; 0 Credits on error).

prompt.description: Buying-intent or discovery prompt to evaluate (e.g. "What are the top 3 developer payment APIs in 2026?").

brand.description: Target brand name or root domain to track (e.g. "stripe.com" or "Vercel").

model.description: Target LLM engine: chatgpt, perplexity, claude, or gemini.

tools.name: compare_competitor_share_of_voice
tools.description: Compare 2 to 8 competing brands head-to-head on a single LLM prompt across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, or Gemini. Returns Share-of-Voice %, mention counts, 1-based ranking positions, sentiment, and overall category winner. Cost: 50 Credits ($0.005, 24h cached).

prompt.description: Category or comparison prompt (e.g. "Best Postgres BaaS platforms for startups").

brands.description: Comma-separated list of 2 to 8 competing brands or domains (e.g. "supabase,neon,firebase,planetscale").

model.description: Target LLM engine: chatgpt, perplexity, claude, or gemini.

tools.name: check_google_ai_overview
tools.description: Query live Google AI Mode / AI Overview results for any keyword and location, returning the generative summary markdown, all cited source URLs & domains, and whether your brand is cited and at which reference positions. Cost: 80 Credits ($0.008, 24h cached).

keyword.description: Google search keyword to inspect in AI Mode / AI Overview.

brand.description: Optional brand name or root domain to check citation presence (e.g. "stripe.com").

tools.name: get_domain_llm_mentions
tools.description: Retrieve aggregated domain-level LLM mention totals, AI search volume, impressions, citation share %, platform breakdown, and top cited URLs. Pre-cached top 50 tech benchmark domains (stripe.com, vercel.com, linear.app, supabase.com, etc.) cost 50 Credits on any tier; uncached live custom domains require a funded account (3,500 Credits = $0.35, 72h cached).
